admission.justification: Without this bound a future task re-adds an inline tree or a whole-tree total to the page, reintroducing unbounded reads on large masters; the component suite pins the single line and the root-only count.

applicability: Every task page whose task carries a notes folder.
conditions: The page shows one Notes line naming the top-folder entry count with a link opening the reader at the notes root.
exclusions: No note rows are drawn on the task page; no total over the tree is computed.
Note content stays in the reader; the page never fetches it.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/TaskNotes.test.tsx; vitest green in full suite 2214

statement: A task page with a notes folder shows one Notes line naming the top-folder entry count with a link opening the reader at the notes root, and computes no total over the tree.
